description: This Java source file contains integration tests for complex search criteria within the persistence layer of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies query functionalities like AND, OR, NOR, and combinations thereof on 'Thing' objects with various attributes.

classes.name: ComplexCriteriaIT
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying complex search criteria logic in persistence layer.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case by inserting predefined 'Thing' objects with various attribute configurations.

methods.name: findAllWithAndCriteria
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'Thing' objects matching all specified attribute values using an AND criteria.

methods.name: findAllWithNoredAndCriteria
methods.description: Tests retrieval using NOR of AND criteria, effectively excluding certain matches.

methods.name: findAllWithOrCriteria
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'Thing' objects matching any of the specified attribute conditions using OR criteria.

methods.name: findAllWithNoredOrCriteria
methods.description: Tests retrieval using NOR of OR criteria to exclude certain attribute matches.

methods.name: findAllWithNorCriteria
methods.description: Tests retrieval when multiple criteria are combined with NOR logic.

methods.name: findAllWithNorNorCriteria
methods.description: Tests nested NOR criteria, verifying exclusion logic.

methods.name: searchForKnownKey
methods.description: Helper method to create criteria matching a specific attribute key with a known value.

methods.name: searchForValue
methods.description: Helper method to create criteria for a specific attribute key with a fixed value.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Populates the test database with 'Thing' objects having various attribute configurations for testing purposes.
